scope: G3 legacy-vs-decomposed parity on push to main
expected: Legacy G3 produces an exact-head check result for every release/main SHA consumed by the G3 aggregator.
actual: The main-push G3 aggregator waited for a check named 'G3 Artifact Integrity Shadow' on the exact main SHA, but the legacy shadow workflow only declared pull_request and workflow_dispatch triggers, so no exact-head legacy check could be produced by the push pipeline.

repair.change: Add push trigger for main while preserving the exact-head checkout and evidence identity contract.

verificationRequired: legacy G3 exact-head check on new main SHA
